newsitem.title: UK: UK s/a M0 fell to 24.720 bln stg in week of Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: UK s/a M0 fell to 24.720 bln stg in week of Dec 11.

text.p: UK M0 money supply fell to 24.720 billion stg on a seasonally adjusted basis, in the week of December 11, the Bank of England said on Monday.
In the previous week, M0 totalled 24.815 billion stg.
Notes and coins totalled 24.670 billion stg in the latest week, on a seasonally adjusted basis, down from 24.728 billion in the week of December 4.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose slightly to 25.349 billion stg in the week of December 11 from 25.170 billion the week before.
